selectionMethod.rankingMeaning: Provisional relative expected local health value of an ordinary gift, under wide uncertainty, used to choose alpha research priorities. Not a measured QALY ordering, recommendation, or ranking of organizational virtue.
dimensions: Severity and plausible counterfactual health gain per affected person.

Donation-sensitive bottleneck versus government reimbursement, reserves and other donors.
Whole-recipient cost and actual LA/Orange resident share, not attractive program-only ratio.

selectionMethod.breadth: Direct clinical/surgery/HIV/hepatitis/mental health; disability/early hearing; air/lead/heat/road-injury/worker policy; legal care access and housing; survivor safety; food-benefit access. No quota by charity size or website quality.
